about: A valid record with two migrate units and one entry in each list. `record` saves it, writes the cut-down record verify-b1-r0.json, and moves the run to verifying with fixing [u1, u2]. The cut-down units keep id, action, sources, copies (creates_note included, as written), edits, and status, and lose trigger, status_from, and why. Each left_in_place, questions, and could_not entry keeps only its source; the could_not entry with no source is dropped. The notes stay as the migrator wrote them.
